name: Dara Okafor
bio: Fictional eval persona. Founder of Quillmark, a made-up seed-stage startup building Sieve, an evaluation tool for AI support assistants. Former head of platform at Pellucid Logistics (fictional). Maintains Gullwing, an open-source prompt-diff CLI.
writing_rules: Lead with what happened, then what it means
One number per post is enough
target_audience: Founders and support leaders putting AI assistants in front of customers
opinions: An eval set is the most honest product spec a team has
A model judge without a human audit is a guess
Write the docs before the code
writing_samples: Our eval suite passed at 94%. For three days our assistant told customers the wrong refund policy. Nobody had asked it about refunds.
I said no to the best whiteboard candidate we interviewed. His pull request descriptions were one line long.
We rolled back a nine-month migration in month five. It was the best thing that happened to the project.
Most AI demos answer the question they were built for. Ask them the second question.
